use.flag: Pull in sys-apps/ai-jail, the sandbox the compiled-in Agent Sandbox starts the Claude agents in, per project, once its lock is switched on
Pull in dev-util/claude-agent-acp-plus, the ACP agent the compiled-in integration patches talk to
Pull in dev-util/claude-agent-acp-tui, the ACP bridge that runs the Claude Code TUI in the agent panel
Pull in app-accessibility/whisper-models for the default speech model of the compiled-in voice input (the microphone button and ctrl-alt-v); transcription runs on this machine
Pull in dev-util/claude-code, the CLI that connects to the compiled-in IDE integration (unofficial reverse-engineered protocol) from Zeo-spawned terminals

pkgmetadata.longdescription: The prebuilt form of app-editors/zeo at the same version: the same Zed commit, the same patch series and the default USE set, compiled for x86-64-v3 (Haswell / Zen 1 and newer). PROVENANCE.txt, installed with the documentation, names the commit, every patch with its sha256, the USE set and the compiler flags.
